label: К
description: Motion toward a person, place, or goal. This pack focuses on going to or toward something or someone.

missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Motion toward a target. 1. 'К дому' means toward the house. 2. 'Иду' is motion on foot. 3. This is a classic direction phrase.
Strategic focus: Direction toward a person. 1. 'К тебе' is the target person. 2. 'Иду' is first-person motion. 3. The sentence is very common in real conversation.
Strategic focus: Motion toward a person with a role. 1. 'К врачу' means to the doctor. 2. 'Идет' is the motion verb. 3. This is a strong practical survival sentence.
Strategic focus: Motion toward an object/location. 1. 'К машине' marks the destination. 2. 'Идем' is plural motion. 3. This sentence is easy to picture and type.
Strategic focus: Completed approach. 1. 'Подошла' is a completed movement verb. 2. 'К окну' marks the destination. 3. This sentence shows the use of 'к' with movement toward a point.
Strategic focus: Plural completed approach. 1. 'Подошли' is plural past. 2. 'К двери' marks the endpoint of movement. 3. The sentence is practical and easy to reuse.
Strategic focus: Ongoing approach. 1. 'Подхожу' is present tense. 2. 'К столу' marks the thing approached. 3. This sentence contrasts ongoing and completed motion.
Strategic focus: Returning to an activity. 1. 'К работе' marks the thing you return to. 2. 'Возвращаемся' is a reflexive motion verb. 3. This is a useful real-world work phrase.

Strategic focus: Fixed verb-governed direction-like relation. 1. 'Привык к' is a very common Russian pattern. 2. 'К шуму' marks the thing one adapts to. 3. This sentence is valuable because it broadens the meaning of 'к'.
Strategic focus: Preparation toward an event. 1. 'К экзамену' marks a future target. 2. 'Готовится' is reflexive and common. 3. This is a very practical student sentence.
Strategic focus: Group preparation. 1. 'К поездке' marks the upcoming event. 2. 'Готовимся' is first-person plural reflexive. 3. This sentence is useful for travel planning.
Strategic focus: Direction toward a building/place. 1. 'К школе' means toward the school. 2. 'Идут' is plural motion. 3. The sentence contrasts with 'в школу' in a subtle way.
Strategic focus: Completed approach in the past. 1. 'Подошел' is the masculine past form. 2. 'К двери' marks the endpoint. 3. This sentence is a strong motion contrast example.
Strategic focus: Future approach. 1. 'Подойду' is future tense. 2. 'К тебе' marks the target person. 3. This sentence is excellent for conversational planning.
Strategic focus: Motion toward a person. 1. 'К другу' means to a friend. 2. 'Идет' is motion on foot. 3. The sentence is short and highly reusable.
Strategic focus: Completed motion toward a person. 1. 'Пошли' is plural past motion. 2. 'К соседу' marks the person being approached. 3. This is a common real-life visiting sentence.
Strategic focus: Fixed abstract phrase. 1. 'К выводу' means to a conclusion. 2. 'Пришла' is a completed event. 3. This sentence teaches that 'к' can lead into abstract destinations too.
Strategic focus: Motion toward a person and place. 1. 'К тебе' marks the person. 2. 'Домой' clarifies the destination as the home. 3. This sentence is rich but still very natural.
Strategic focus: Vehicle motion toward a group. 1. 'К нам' marks the direction. 2. 'Едут' is vehicle motion, not walking. 3. This sentence is ideal for travel and visits.

missions.phrase: она идет к нему на работу
missions.fullAnalysis: Strategic focus: Direction plus purpose. 1. 'К нему' is the target person. 2. 'На работу' adds the purpose or destination context. 3. This sentence combines two important movement ideas cleanly.
